cards.existing: Use `ты` (ty)-form with friends/family/kids, `вы`-form for strangers, groups, or formality. The plural -ите ending also marks politeness.

cards.english: Take care of yourself!
cards.existing: To say "about X" use `о` / `об` + noun in -е: `думаю о доме` (dumayu o dome = thinking about home). `Об` before vowel-initial words: `об отце` (ob ottse = about dad).

cards.existing: Perfective verb forms (often with prefixes like `по-`, `про-`, `с-`, `на-`) describe completed, one-time actions: `я прочитал книгу` (I read [and finished] the book).

cards.existing: 3rd-person plural endings: `-ют/-ут` (first conjugation: читают, идут), `-ят/-ат` (second conjugation: говорят, кричат). 'They' do it.

cards.existing: First and second person can use either: `я люблю мою/свою жену` are both fine. Third person almost always needs `свой` (svoy) for clarity.
